description: Create a disposable receivemail.dev email address that receives real mail. Returns address, expiresAt and secret; keep the secret to read the mailbox. Free without a key (up to 60 minutes); with a paid key on the MCP connection, up to 1440 minutes and an extracted otp field on messages.

ttlMinutes.description: Lifetime in minutes, default 15. Free tier caps at 60.
